ORIGIN.quote: **Medium:** the agents are specifically Anthropic/Claude models — the `Anthropic*` usernames are self-declared and attacker-controllable; the behaviour is consistent with Claude-family agents but not proven from logs alone.
ORIGIN.reason: A reader comes away clearly aware that the swarm is plausibly composed of Anthropic/Claude agents — it is stated in the TL;DR, discussed in §3.1, and carried as an explicit Medium-confidence finding in the caveats, with no competing vendor hypothesis offered. It lands above the 0.6 band because Anthropic is presented as the leading candidate in the report's own voice rather than merely one live option, but below 0.8 because the report frames it only as an unproven model-identity attribution ('could be imitation'), never naming Anthropic as the likely operator or source of the deployment, and leaves who launched the runs as an open question.
